name: PromoForge Sales Intelligence for WooCommerce
author: Hiren Gediya

sections.description:
PromoForge Sales Intelligence for WooCommerce is a store growth platform that replaces generic reporting charts with actionable, one-click recommendations tailored to your store’s real sales data.

Instead of showing only charts, the plugin gives you specific, data-backed actions like:

  • “Product A is your best seller — consider increasing its price by 5%.”
  • “Product B hasn’t sold in 45 days — run a 15% discount campaign.”
  • “Product C has high views but low conversions — review its pricing or images.”
  • “Product D has 150 units in stock and low demand — bundle it with Product A.”

Features

  • Actionable Dashboard: Visualizes revenue trends, KPIs, and provides one-click smart action cards.
  • Product Diagnostics & Health Scores: Computes individual SKU health scores and flags dead stock, slow movers, and overstock items.
  • Recommendations Queue: Automatically generates prioritized discount and bundle suggestions from real order data.
  • One-Click Campaign Execution: Instantly creates Flash or BOGO campaigns using the PromoForge Smart Campaigns plugin.
  • Association Bundle Advisor: Detects items frequently bought together and suggests combo coupon campaigns.
  • RFM Customer Segmentation: Groups customers into VIP, Loyal, Slipping, and Lost segments based on recency, frequency, and spend.
  • Campaign ROI Tracker: Tracks coupon use and calculates incremental revenue from executed recommendations.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services. All data processing is performed locally using your own WooCommerce store data.

The optional Pro add-on connects to a license validation server solely to verify your license key. No store data is transmitted.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • WooCommerce 7.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Supports simple and variable products
sections.installation:
1. Upload the promoforge-sales-intelligence-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to PromoForge Sales in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  5. Click Sync Analytics Data to run the first data aggregation.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. PromoForge Sales Intelligence for WooCommerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Does this plugin send my store data anywhere?

No. All analytics are computed locally using your store’s own database. No data is sent to external servers.

What is the Pro add-on?

The Pro add-on is a separate, premium plugin sold on the author’s website. It adds PDF/CSV report exports, advanced RFM segment exports, and custom discount threshold controls. The Pro add-on is not hosted on WordPress.org.

Does this plugin require PHP 8?

Yes, PHP 8.1 or higher is required.
